name: Mushroom Matar
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each coriander powder and garam masala
¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp chilli powder
steps: Dry-sauté the mushrooms in a hot pan for 5 minutes until browned; set aside.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, then cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add ginger and garlic.
Add the tomato purée and spices and cook for 6 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the peas, mushrooms and ½ cup water and simmer for 6 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, salt and coriander.
note: Browning the mushrooms first drives off moisture and deepens the flavour.
